milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find ladder' is an observe/locate task. The ladder is at spawn-relative (-1, 2, 8) on the back wall of the building. The player must navigate inside the building and be close enough to the ladder while facing it to have visually identified it. max_distance=5 ensures the player is inside the building near the back wall, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward the ladder.

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find tripwire' is an observe/locate task. The tripwire is at spawn-relative (0.5, 5, 5) on the rooftop (midpoint between the two hooks). The player must climb the ladder to reach the roof (y=4+) and face the tripwire. max_distance=5 ensures the player is on the roof near the tripwire, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward it. Being on the roof at y>=4 and within 5 blocks of the tripwire at y=5 inherently requires having climbed the ladder.
